import json
BP={"refPath":"/Game/Gameplay/UI/V2/WBP_UIRoot.WBP_UIRoot"}
ASSET="/Game/Gameplay/UI/V2/WBP_UIRoot"
U="UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet."
O="editor_toolset.toolsets.object.ObjectTools."
A="editor_toolset.toolsets.asset.AssetTools."
BASE_PAGES=["Screen_Menu","Screen_Gameplay","Screen_Hub","Screen_Wardrobe","Screen_Boosters","Screen_Tools","Screen_Perks","Screen_Settings","Screen_Team"]
NEW_PAGES=[(9,"Screen_Reward"),(10,"Screen_Frontend"),(11,"Screen_GameplayMenu")]
VIEWS=[
    ("Screen_Reward","RewardViewport","RewardViewportFrame","UnifiedReward","/Game/Gameplay/UI/V2/WBP_UIReward.WBP_UIReward_C"),
    ("Screen_Frontend","FrontendViewport","FrontendViewportFrame","UnifiedFrontend","/Game/Gameplay/UI/V2/WBP_UIFrontend.WBP_UIFrontend_C"),
    ("Screen_GameplayMenu","GameplayMenuViewport","GameplayMenuViewportFrame","UnifiedGameplayMenu","/Game/Gameplay/UI/V2/WBP_UIGameplayMenu.WBP_UIGameplayMenu_C"),
]
def call(name,params):
    result=execute_tool(name,json.dumps(params))
    assert "returnValue" in result,(name,result)
    return result["returnValue"]
def ref(value):return value["refPath"] if isinstance(value,dict) else value

def tree():return call(U+"GetWidgets",{"widgetBlueprint":BP})
def update(obj,desired):
    schema=json.loads(call(O+"list_properties",{"instance":obj}))
    normalize=lambda value:value.lower().replace("_","")
    values={}
    for wanted,value in desired.items():
        key=next((key for key in schema if normalize(key)==normalize(wanted)),None)
        assert key,(wanted,list(schema))
        values[key]=value
        if wanted.endswith("DesiredHeight") or wanted.endswith("DesiredWidth"):
            flag=next((key for key in schema if normalize(key)==normalize("bOverride"+wanted)),None)
            assert flag,(wanted,"Missing SizeBox override flag")
            values[flag]=True
    call(O+"get_properties",{"instance":obj,"properties":list(values)})
    assert call(O+"set_properties",{"instance":obj,"values":json.dumps(values)})
def run():
    # Run editor_preflight_python immediately before this script. The Programmatic
    # sandbox cannot import unreal; it can independently guard the target package.
    assert not call(A+"is_dirty",{"asset_path":ASSET}),"Preserve an unsaved root Blueprint"
    initial=tree()
    d={widget["widgetName"]:widget for widget in initial["widgets"]}
    assert len(d)==len(initial["widgets"]),"Ambiguous existing widget names"
    assert "InterfaceScreens" in d and "Screen_Hub" in d
    assert ref(d["InterfaceScreens"]["widgetClassPath"])=="/Script/UMG.WidgetSwitcher"
    assert ref(d["Screen_Hub"]["widgetClassPath"])=="/Script/UMG.CanvasPanel"
    switcher=d["InterfaceScreens"]["widget"]
    siblings=[widget["widgetName"] for widget in initial["widgets"] if ref(widget["parent"])==ref(switcher)]
    assert siblings[:len(BASE_PAGES)]==BASE_PAGES,("Preserve existing page order",siblings)
    # Validate every existing target before any mutation. No remove/move/rebuild calls.
    expected=[("UnifiedHub","/Game/Gameplay/UI/V2/WBP_UIHub.WBP_UIHub_C","Screen_Hub")]
    expected += [(name,"/Script/UMG.CanvasPanel","InterfaceScreens") for _,name in NEW_PAGES]
    for page,host,frame,view,cls in VIEWS:
        expected += [(host,"/Script/UMG.ScrollBox",page),(frame,"/Script/UMG.SizeBox",host),
                     (host+"Horizontal","/Script/UMG.ScrollBox",frame),(host+"Content","/Script/UMG.SizeBox",host+"Horizontal"),(view,cls,host+"Content")]
    for name,cls,parent in expected:
        if name in d:
            assert parent in d,("Preserve a detached/conflicting branch",name,parent)
            assert ref(d[name]["widgetClassPath"])==cls,("Preserve unrelated widget class",name,d[name]["widgetClassPath"])
            assert ref(d[name]["parent"])==ref(d[parent]["widget"]),("Preserve authored hierarchy",name,parent)
    simulated=list(siblings)
    for index,page in NEW_PAGES:
        if page in d:
            assert len(simulated)>index and simulated[index]==page,("Unexpected existing page index",index,page,simulated)
        else:
            assert len(simulated)==index,("Cannot append without reordering existing pages",index,page,simulated)
            simulated.append(page)
    created=[]
    preserved=[]
    def ensure(cls,name,parent,index=-1):
        if name in d:
            preserved.append(name)
            return d[name],False
        item=call(U+"AddWidget",{"widgetBlueprint":BP,"widgetClass":{"refPath":cls},"widgetDisplayName":name,"parentWidget":d[parent]["widget"],"childIndex":index})
        assert item and item["widgetName"]==name,("Widget was not appended with the expected identity",name,item)
        assert ref(item["parent"])==ref(d[parent]["widget"]),("Unexpected new parent",name,item)
        d[name]=item
        created.append(name)
        return item,True
    for index,page in NEW_PAGES:
        ensure("/Script/UMG.CanvasPanel",page,"InterfaceScreens",index)
    hub,is_new=ensure("/Game/Gameplay/UI/V2/WBP_UIHub.WBP_UIHub_C","UnifiedHub","Screen_Hub")
    if is_new:
        update(hub["widget"],{"visibility":"SelfHitTestInvisible"})
        update(hub["slot"],{"layoutData":{"offsets":{"left":0,"top":0,"right":0,"bottom":0},"anchors":{"minimum":{"x":0,"y":0},"maximum":{"x":1,"y":1}},"alignment":{"x":0,"y":0}},"bAutoSize":False})
    for page,host,frame,view,cls in VIEWS:
        viewport,new_host=ensure("/Script/UMG.ScrollBox",host,page)
        bounds,new_frame=ensure("/Script/UMG.SizeBox",frame,host)
        across,new_across=ensure("/Script/UMG.ScrollBox",host+"Horizontal",frame)
        width,new_width=ensure("/Script/UMG.SizeBox",host+"Content",host+"Horizontal")
        component,new_view=ensure(cls,view,host+"Content")
        if new_across:update(across["widget"],{"orientation":"Orient_Horizontal","scrollBarVisibility":"Collapsed","scrollWhenFocusChanges":"InstantScroll"})
        if new_width:update(width["widget"],{"minDesiredWidth":1856})
        if new_host:
            update(viewport["widget"],{"scrollBarVisibility":"Collapsed","scrollWhenFocusChanges":"InstantScroll"})
            update(viewport["slot"],{"layoutData":{"offsets":{"left":32,"top":32,"right":32,"bottom":32},"anchors":{"minimum":{"x":0,"y":0},"maximum":{"x":1,"y":1}},"alignment":{"x":0,"y":0}},"bAutoSize":False})
        if new_frame:
            update(bounds["widget"],{"minDesiredHeight":1016})
            update(bounds["slot"],{"horizontalAlignment":"HAlign_Fill"})
        if new_view:update(component["slot"],{"horizontalAlignment":"HAlign_Left","verticalAlignment":"VAlign_Center"})
    assert call(U+"CompileWidgetBlueprint",{"widgetBlueprint":BP})
    assert call(A+"save_assets",{"asset_paths":[ASSET]})
    final=tree()
    final_siblings=[widget["widgetName"] for widget in final["widgets"] if ref(widget["parent"])==ref(switcher)]
    assert final_siblings[:12]==BASE_PAGES+[page for _,page in NEW_PAGES],final_siblings
    final_by_name={widget["widgetName"]:widget for widget in final["widgets"]}
    assert all(name in final_by_name for name in d),"Existing root widget was lost"
    return {"saved":True,"created":created,"existingTargetsPreserved":preserved,"pageIndices":{page:index for index,page in NEW_PAGES},
            "hub":"Screen_Hub/UnifiedHub; full canvas anchors with zero offsets","info":final["info"],
            "policy":"Append only; existing class, hierarchy and page indices checked; existing properties untouched."}
